title: pvTableToPoints
body:
## pvTableToPoints

Turns a table (e.g. a CSV file of x, y, z samples) into polydata points: three numeric columns give the coordinates and the other columns become point arrays. The coordinate columns are removed from the arrays unless KeepAllDataArrays is on; with a2DPoints the Z column is ignored and z = 0. Use it to place measurement or particle data in space for probing, interpolation or glyphs.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Name XColumn, YColumn and ZColumn explicitly; otherwise ParaView picks columns itself, possibly the wrong ones.
- Coordinates are used as given; convert units (e.g. millimetres to metres) upstream if the mesh uses different units.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TableToPoints`. Identity: `filters/TableToPolyData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input. Accepted data: tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable). The input needs at least one row (table) array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KeepAllDataArrays` | Keep columns specified as X,Y,Z as Data arrays. By default this will be off. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `XColumn` | This property specifies which data array is going to be used as the X coordinate in the generated polydata dataset. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `YColumn` | This property specifies which data array is going to be used as the Y coordinate in the generated polydata dataset. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ZColumn` | This property specifies which data array is going to be used as the Z coordinate in the generated polydata dataset. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `a2DPoints` | Specify whether the points of the polydata are 3D or 2D. If this is set to true then the Z Column will be ignored and the Z value of each point on the polydata will be set to 0. By default this will be off. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTableToPoints",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
